exposure: Duration of second stage of labor
cohort: Asymptomatic postpartum women who experienced an uncomplicated vaginal delivery and were at low risk of developing postpartum urinary retention.
finding: The prevalence of covert postpartum urinary retention was 7.1%, with primiparity, prolonged second stage of labor, and obstetric injury correlating with higher initial postvoid residual volume.
mod_finding: The study focused exclusively on uncomplicated vaginal deliveries, identifying a prolonged second stage of labor as a factor correlated with higher initial postvoid residual volume.
